definitionZh: 边框-内线宽度 CSS 属性定义一个元素的逻辑内线边框的宽度,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框宽度. 它与边框-上宽和边框-下宽,或边框-左宽,以及边框-右宽属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向和文字导向定义的值.
sourceDefinition: The border-inline-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width and border-bottom-width, or border-left-width, and border-right-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
